chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding the saying of the Mighty and Majestic:
'Corruption has appeared in the land and the sea on account of what the hands of people have wrought'
He said: That was, by God, when the Ansar said, 'From us [should be] a commander and from you [should be] a commander.'

key_terms.أمير: Commander/Emir — ruler or leader with political authority
key_terms.الأنصار: The Ansar — the Medinan Muslims who aided the Prophet after his migration from Mecca
key_terms.الفساد: Corruption/disruption in the social and political order
key_terms.سقيفة: Saqifa — the meeting hall where the dispute over leadership took place after the Prophet's death

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about corruption in the land and sea in Quran 30:41?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) interprets Quran 30:41 — 'corruption has appeared in the land and the sea by what the hands of people have wrought' — as referring to the crisis at Saqifa after the Prophet's death, when the Ansar proposed dividing leadership by saying 'from us an Emir and from you an Emir.' This interpretation frames the political fragmentation following the Prophet's death as the root cause of the 'corruption' spoken of in this Quranic verse. The audience would have understood this as a pointed indictment of the events that led to the deviation from the rightful succession of Imam Ali (AS).
